decisions.reason: The chart plugin still fits the firm's web-mapping stack and likely remains near aspiration, though as a modular add-on it could be withdrawn or absorbed into the core platform if results soften.
As the firm's flagship GIS platform and focal strategic direction, it would usually be retained unless performance fell clearly and persistently below aspiration.

Mobile field data capture is adjacent to the core business and useful in enterprise GIS projects, but it requires continued investment and faces a higher risk of failing to meet aspiration than the flagship platform.

The search extension complements web map applications and uses existing capabilities, but as a narrower feature product it is more exposed to problemistic reallocation if uptake remains only modest relative to aspiration.
